resources.string: Run /call in pi on your computer and paste the pairing code it shows here.
That is not a valid Sdot pairing code. Copy the whole code that starts with sdot1:.
This pairing code uses an insecure address. Sdot only connects over HTTPS.
This pairing code has an invalid token. Run /call in pi again and copy the new code.
To call again you will need a new pairing code from /call in pi.

Offline speech recognition is not available on this phone. Install or update Speech Recognition and Synthesis from Google (or another on-device speech engine), download the offline pack for your language in the phone\'s speech settings, then call again. You can still hear the agent.
Downloading the offline speech pack for %1$s. Listening starts as soon as it is ready.
Offline speech recognition does not support %1$s on this phone. Download an offline pack for another language in the phone\'s speech settings or change the phone language.
Sdot needs the microphone to hear you. Allow it in Settings, Apps, Sdot, Permissions.
Your computer rejected this pairing. Run /call in pi again, unpair, and pair with the new code.
Could not deliver what you said. Check the connection to your computer.
Could not stop the agent. Check the connection to your computer.
Text-to-speech is not available. Install or enable a speech engine in the phone settings.

For a more natural voice, install Speech Services by Google, then in Settings, Text-to-speech output, choose it as the preferred engine and use Install voice data to download the voice for your language.
Could not start the call. Open Sdot, allow the microphone, and try again.
Confirm the update in the Android install prompt.
Android needs your permission before Sdot can install updates. Open settings, allow Install unknown apps for Sdot, then come back and tap Download & install.
Could not check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
GitHub did not answer as expected (HTTP %1$s). Try again later.
The latest release could not be read.
Release v%1$s has no APK to install.
The download failed or was incomplete. Try again.
The downloaded file is not a newer version of Sdot, so it was not installed.

This update is signed with a different key than the installed app, which was probably built locally (a debug build). Uninstall Sdot once and install the release APK from the releases page; after that, updates work from this button.
Android could not install the update (%1$s).
